verdict.rationale: Teller's transactions API documents a category field with a Teller-defined set of categorization values, so categorization is a first-party platform capability. Nothing in the pack shows cleaned or normalized merchant names or merchant logos. missing for 10: cleaned merchant-name enrichment, merchant logos, depth/accuracy documentation of categorization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, raw bank transactions come back enriched — cleaned merchant names, categories, and logos — documented as a capability of the platform, not left as an exercise for me
